name: Calendar
description: Mortar calendar: a month grid with keyboard navigation (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown), today and selection states, and events as dots (compact) or titles (full). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings handled in UTC.

props.events: CalendarEvent[] ({ id: string; date: string; title: string; time?: string })

contract.usage: Import { Calendar } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
